title: USDA's FoodData Central: what is it and why is it needed today?
authors: Fukagawa NK, McKillop K, Pehrsson PR, Moshfegh A, Harnly J, Finley J
funder: All authors are employed by the USDA Agricultural Research Service and have not received external support in the preparation of this manuscript.
result: FoodData Central is the USDA food-composition data system; Foundation Foods carry analytical values with sample metadata. Foundation Foods entry read on 2026-10-21: Salt, table, iodized (FDC 746775, 24 samples purchased from 2018), per 100 g: water 0.42 g, ash 99.0 g, sodium 38,700 mg (range 37,200 to 40,700), iodine 5,080 µg (3,410 to 7,430), calcium 50 mg (0 to 125), potassium 2 mg (0 to 53), energy 0 kcal; 1 teaspoon = 6.1 g.
